title: Cycle Double Cover Conjecture
exact_target: Can every edge of a finite bridgeless graph be covered exactly twice by a list of cycles?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1327 (GRAPH-003). CC BY 4.0.
Sang-il Oum, \emph{A proof of the cycle double cover conjecture by OpenAI: An exposition} (2026), arXiv:2607.16356v3, Section 1, Theorem 1, pp. 1--2.
